sentences.en: The mountain ash is blooming. It's time to sow flax.
sentences.zh: 山杨树开花了。是时候播种亚麻了。

sentences.en: I eat bread covered with flax seeds, which end up all over the table.
sentences.zh: 我吃涂有亚麻籽的面包，结果这些种子撒得到处都是。

sentences.en: She uses flax to make clothing and bags because it is durable.
sentences.zh: 她用亚麻制作衣物和包，因为它很耐用。

senses.zh: [植]亚麻；[植]亚麻纤维；亚麻织品；亚麻布
